sentences.text: We allow the present appeals in part.

The impugned common judgment and order passed by the High Court in respect of First Appeals is hereby modified and all these appeals are disposed of in terms of the order passed by this Court in Jaspal Singh and Others (supra).

It is observed that the original claimants shall be entitled to the compensation to the tune at Rs.22 lakhs per acre alongwith all other statutory benefits which will be available under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894.
The present appeals are accordingly allowed to the aforesaid extent.
No costs.
